title: detection, version 1
description: Edge computer to coordinator over MQTT on briech/v1/edge/<source_id>/detection, up to 10 per second per source. geo is left out when the target has no ground position (for example above the horizon); a made-up position is never sent.

track_id.description: The edge tracker id. Stable for one object on one camera.

bbox.description: Box in the frame, 0 to 1, from the top-left corner.

late.description: True when sent from the disk queue more than 60 s after it was made. No live alert is raised from it.
